verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no production call monitoring, dashboards, metrics, or alerting for agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. Behavioral tests, simulations and deployment rollback are pre-production or adjacent features, not live monitoring. A community report describes having 'no way to measure' latency or per-call metrics, which reinforces the absence rather than contradicting a vendor claim.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
